summary: Lattice observation tower in Sumter County at 351 ft per a Georgia list and OpenStreetMap; no source found gives its build date, status or access.

evidence.supports: Tower is listed as De Soto Lookout Tower in Sumter County at 351 ft elevation, 31.98711, -84.05796
Source is a list of Georgia lookout towers
Map behind the list was last revised in March 2016
OpenStreetMap entry carries the name De Soto Lookout Tower
Eastern US Lookouts list includes a De Soto entry
That De Soto entry is in Sumter County

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources are one list row, one volunteer-edited OpenStreetMap node (id 358721821, version 3, no agency, date or height tags read), and one Eastern US Lookouts name entry with no notes. Story is about 95 words, below the 120-word floor; hold it if the floor is strict. The Eastern US Lookouts De Soto entry carries no notes, and the 2006 auction notes on that page sit beside other entries, so they are not tied to De Soto and were not used. Searches found no history of this tower. Brief record checks out on county and elevation; no corrections proposed.
